passage.label: O believed do not put yourselves before Allah Messenger fear Allah Hearing Knowing; do not raise voices above voice Prophet loud speech like loudness some others lest deeds become worthless perceive not; lower voices before Messenger hearts tested righteousness forgiveness great reward; call you behind chambers most not use reason; patient until come out better Forgiving Merciful; disobedient one information investigate lest harm people ignorance become regretful; know among you Messenger Allah obey much matter difficulty; endeared faith made pleasing hearts made hateful disbelief defiance disobedience rightly guided; bounty favour Allah Knowing Wise

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَرۡفَعُوٓاْ أَصۡوَٰتَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ صَوۡتِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجۡهَرُواْ لَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ كَجَهۡرِ بَعۡضِكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ أَن تَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصۡوَٰتَهُمۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمۡتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰۚ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٌ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلۡحُجُرَٰتِ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخۡرُجَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن جَآءَكُمۡ فَاسِقُۢ بِنَبَإٖ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓاْ أَن تُصِيبُواْ قَوۡمَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٖ فَتُصۡبِحُواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلۡتُمۡ نَٰدِمِينَ

وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ فِيكُمۡ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِۚ لَوۡ يُطِيعُكُمۡ فِي كَثِيرٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ لَعَنِتُّمۡ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِي قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡكُفۡرَ وَٱلۡفُسُوقَ وَٱلۡعِصۡيَانَۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّـٰشِدُونَ
فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعۡمَةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٞ

mainSubject.label: Believers commanded not to precede Allah and His Messenger but to fear Him, the Hearing Knowing; prohibition against raising voices above the Prophet's or being loud as with peers, lest deeds become worthless unperceived; those lowering their voices identified as having hearts tested for righteousness earning forgiveness and great reward; callers from behind the chambers named as mostly lacking reason, patience noted as better under divine forgiveness and mercy; the fasiq-information rule requiring investigation to prevent ignorant harm and subsequent regret; the Prophet's presence among them affirmed with obedience-warning that excessive compliance would cause difficulty, countered by Allah endearing faith and making it pleasing while rendering disbelief, defiance and disobedience hateful — those being the guided; this framed as bounty and favour from the Knowing Wise

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: If there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate.

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the bounty-and-favour framing (8) before the inter-believer conflict rules open (9); P2 ends with the universal nobility-by-righteousness declaration (13) before the bedouin iman-submission distinction begins (14); P3 runs from that distinction through the true-believer definition, the favour reversal and the closing unseen-knowledge affirmation (14-18).
